text:
Dr. Sanduk Ruit was conferred the National Order of Merit of Bhutan in Gold on 17 December 2018, which is Bhutan's National Day. I'm going from memory and haven't checked a source. The team note puts the ceremony in March around the Thimphu Tshechu, but it gives no source, and it doesn't match what I remember, so I'm keeping December.

CONFIDENCE: 50
